missing_evidence: Order-service logs/traces showing the internal cause of its 500 responses
Order-service metrics for error rate and dependency outcomes
candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order:8000 failing with 500, so the checkout 502s originate from order-service server errors.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order service (db, payment, inventory) is not established; only the 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s are explained by order-service 500s: traces and logs show POST /v1/orders to order:8000 returning 500, propagated as 502 on /v1/checkout. The specific fault inside order service is not yet evidenced, so the candidate is bounded to the observed 500 propagation.
